verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs claim security features including user permission management and access control lists, and say repository collaborators can be managed. That is first-party permission capability, but nothing shows at which levels it applies. Missing for 10: documented organization/team-level permissions, project-level permissions, branch-level protection rules, environment-level permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of granular access control.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can assign granular permissions at organization, project, repository, branch, and environment level

citations.quote: offering features such as user permission management, access control lists, and more to ensure the security of code and data
managing collaborators, handling branches, and more
